scientific_interpretation: P20 introduces a bounded REAL pretrained-root LoRA training and heldout closed-loop execution path; no target SLM checkpoint or new gameplay score exists yet.

previous_valid_control.conclusion: Competence gating mitigated STOP collapse but failed to beat reward PBT or random-parent baselines; no further nearby selector variant is justified.

p20.architecture: pretrained SmolLM2 plus rank-4 alpha-8 q_proj/v_proj LoRA in last 2 layers, separate trained six-action head
limitations: synthetic legal host approximates CyberSand game; not native ABI validation
hand-designed niche reward and structured text cues
small update budget does not guarantee meaningful generalization
selection-only competence flags do not establish aesthetic diversity
source publication and mechanical guardrails are not empirical SLM reproduction
